author: Kozela, A.E.A.
title: Measurement of transverse polarization of electrons emitted in free neutron decay
abstract: The final analysis of the experiment determining both components of the transverse polarization of electrons (sigma_T1, sigma_T2) emitted in the beta-decay of polarized, free neutrons is presented. The T-odd, P-odd correlation coefficient quantifying sigma_T2, perpendicular to the neutron polarization and electron momentum, was found to be R = 0.004(12)(5).
